title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description:
Given an unsorted array of integers nums, return the length of the longest consecutive elements sequence.

You must write an algorithm that runs in O(n) time.
prompt: Implement a function to find the length of the longest consecutive sequence of elements in an unsorted array.
hints: A brute force approach would be to sort the array and then count the longest consecutive sequence. However, sorting takes O(n log n) time. How can we optimize this to O(n)?
Consider using a Hash Set to store all the numbers. This allows for O(1) lookups.

To avoid redundant work, only start counting a sequence if the current number is the actual beginning of a sequence. How do you check if a number is the start of a sequence? (Hint: check if num - 1 exists in the set).
follow_ups: Can you solve this problem using the Union-Find (Disjoint Set) data structure?
What if the array elements are streamed one by one? How would you maintain the length of the longest consecutive sequence efficiently?
